steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Enable the required tenant configuration before opening the create flow.
Enable the required read-only ceiling-price configuration.
Set the event type to RFQ and open the Configuration for Event window.
Close the initial configuration window so the RFQ can be prepared.
Provide the mandatory event title without implying that the event will be saved.
Apply the requested Buy pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Reopen the RFQ Configuration for Event window after product setup.
Perform the behavior under test: cancel configuration without saving.
Verify that the configuration window has closed.
Navigate to the events list to check that cancellation did not create the event.
Verify that the events list rendered without an application error.
Assert that the unsaved test event is not present in the list.
